title: Rhythmic String
statement: The task is to delete the fewest array elements (sum of n up to 5000, values up to 10^9) so that marking every multiple of each kept value in a huge binary string makes it rhythmic, with exactly one 1 per period. The period must equal the smallest kept value, so all kept values must be its multiples; an O(n^2) count of multiples per candidate minimum gives the answer.
